result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Extract the audios from a VAB or VH/VB format

USAGE:
    HinoxUtils.dll audio vab export [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                                   DEFAULT                                      
    -h, --help                                Prints help information           
        --vab                                 Path to the VAB file. Ignore if VH
                                              and VB paths are provided         
        --vh                                  Path to the VH file (VAB header). 
                                              Ignore if VAB path is provided    
        --vb                                  Path to the VB file (VAB body).   
                                              Ignore if VAB path is provided    
        --files                               Optional path to a previously     
                                              exported files.yml for having     
                                              custom names when exporting       
    -o, --output                              Path to the directory to write the
                                              output files                      
        --support-non-compliant               Support non-compliant formats     
    -v, --verbosity                Warning    Logging output verbosity          

Success!

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Import audio files into VAB or VH/VB format

USAGE:
    HinoxUtils.dll audio vab import [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                            DEFAULT                                             
    -h, --help                         Prints help information                  
    -f, --files                        Path to the files.yml with the audio     
                                       paths to import                          
        --header                       Path to the vab.yml with the VAB header  
                                       information                              
        --out-vab                      Export content as VAB format into the    
                                       provided path                            
        --out-vh                       Export the header as VH format into the  
                                       provided path                            
        --out-vb                       Export the body container as VB format   
                                       into the provided path                   
        --autodetect-vag               If set, it tries to autodetect VAG       
                                       headers in audio files                   
    -v, --verbosity         Warning    Logging output verbosity                 

Success!
